lines.speaker: Elara
lines.text: There you are! I saved us a table by the window. The whole tower's quiet tonight.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It's been a long week. I could use the company.

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.text: Then stay a while. Tell me — what's been on your mind lately?

choices.text: "Just glad to be here with you."
"I've been pushing my magic too hard."

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.text: Then rest. Even the brightest flame gutters if you never let it breathe. Promise me you'll sleep tonight?

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.text: You always know what to say. Same time next week?
